column3: The Blog page has the same intro ("What's on in San Diego") and the same three categories as Happenings. Two pages with the same headings compete with each other. Each needs its own angle.
"The best San Diego hotels for every kind of traveler" sits under culture, and "What's on in San Diego this autumn" under conferences. Worth checking the categories.
The six FAQ questions are the same room questions ("this room") on every page. Each page needs its own questions about its topic. These are the answers AI tools look for.
